delegate core

🤝 Delegate — External Executors, Claude Only Creates and Validates

Claude writes the card and judges; DeepSeek or agy does the work

CLAUDE CREATES AND VALIDATES; EXECUTORS ACT; NOTHING RUNS BEFORE THE USER CONFIRMS THE MODEL.

Why it exists

Run work on external executors with a user-confirmed model choice, a host-run gate, a cross-family review and an append-only audit log, keeping Claude usage to creating cards and validating results.

When to use

  • Work that an external executor can do: implementing a card, fixing review findings, mechanical sweeps
  • You want Claude usage limited to writing the card and validating the result
  • You need comparable, auditable numbers per executor and model

When not to use

  • Deciding what to build or designing it (use brainstorm)
  • A question, a read, or a one-command check with no product change
  • No worktree isolation or no runnable gate is possible for the task

Examples

  • /atomic-skills:delegate T-12 T-13
    Show the batch table, wait for the yes, then run each card on DeepSeek with an agy review
  • /atomic-skills:delegate "fix the review findings on the billing branch"
    Write a fix card, run it on the executor that wrote the code, gate and record
